title: Thunderdome Season 2 NA
wikitext:
== Introduction ==
39 players signed up for Thunderdome season 2 NorthAmerica. One of the success factors for that amount of sign ups compared to other tournaments, probably was the decision to split the tournament up in 3 divisions depending on skill level. Amount of players in each division:

* Pro - 16 players
* Regular - 12 players
* Rookies - 11 players
'''

== Settings, Rules, Maps ==
* Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]], [[ztndm3]], [[aerowalk]]
* Allowed clients: [[FTEQW]] 1.00 with ruleset nqr, [[FodQuake]] 0.2 or 0.3 with -ruleset eql and [[ezQuake]] 2.1 with -ruleset smackdown
* Time limit: 10 minutes
* Overtime 3 minutes
* Deathmatch mode 3
* No Powerups
* No fairpacks
* Discharges enabled
* Ktx2 spawns. (unless both players agree on a different mode)
* Maxfps 77.
* No berzerk, midair, instagib or other unusual modes.
* Fallbunny on.
